**Finding submitted: MISSING (INSURANCE)**

- **Investigation:** Full-document searches for "insurance", "errors and omissions", and fidelity/bond coverage returned only two non-responsive hits — Obligor insurance premiums billed to wireless accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance inside the "Qualified Institution" definition (p0903). No coverage covenant exists in Article VI (Servicer and Marketing Agent) or Article X (Miscellaneous).
- **Direction:** Cellco (Servicer/Custodian) is the counterparty and handles Obligor account and payment data, so an absent insurance covenant is walk-away territory under the rule.
- **Cure:** New Section 10.14 inserted after the last paragraph of Article X, carrying only the two fallback elements (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000). I selected fallback deliberately as the shortest complete cure and did not volunteer the preferred CGL/workers' compensation/certificates package, which is noted in the rationale rather than drafted in.
